correctness.rationale: In the exact model u-dot=(-x+y^2)u, so near (1,0,0), -x+y^2<-1/2 and no nonzero u orbit can be periodic. The invariant plane has the exact translated reversible center system Xdot=-Y+aXY+bX^2Y+cY^3, Ydot=X+X^2+2Y^2+2XY^2, with b=(2a-c)/3+4/9 on the complete center locus. In polar coordinates, rdot=r^2R2+r^3R3 and theta-dot=1+rH1+r^2H2; the reviewed script represents the original-time radial and period recursions by exact rational finite Fourier series, and its T2/T3/T4 integrals contain no time-rescaling. Independent algebra checks confirm that imposing T2=0 gives T3=0 and T4=pi Q(a)/4608; the sum-of-squares decomposition Q(a)=3(a^2-23a/3)^2+(2912/3)(a+1203/364)^2+5396458/91 is globally strictly positive. Hence no choice of the unrestricted real parameters A,D permits all period constants to vanish. An analytic planar elliptic reversible system has a center; no finite test substitutes for the symbolic identities and positivity.
